elements.label: Shrine to the Catgirls
elements.description: My dedication has taken a physical form. A shrine dedicated to the cause of the Catgirls stands tall.
elements.comments: Building and Maintaining Shrines: This could be a new type of work in the game, requiring a certain level of Passion, Health, or Funds to start. Successful shrine building could increase the Catgirl level and possibly also yield a new Remnant or Artifact related to the Catgirls.

elements.label: The Catgirl Channel
elements.description: My channel thrives. The message of the Catgirls spreads through every video I upload.
elements.comments: Catgirl YouTube Channel: Starting a YouTube channel could be a long-term project in the game, possibly under the Study verb, requiring a series of specific Lore fragments to create content. The higher the Lore fragments level used, the more subscribers (represented as a new type of Influence or Remnant) you could attract, and the more your Catgirl level could increase.

elements.label: Defiant Summons
elements.description: The summons has been sent. My defiance of the authorities is a testament to my allegiance to the Catgirls.
elements.comments: Sending Defiant Summons: This could be a new use for the Ritual verb, using Catgirl-related Lore and Ingredients to summon a Catgirl to carry a defiant message to the authorities. This might increase your Catgirl level and Notoriety while reducing your standing with the authorities.

elements.label: Catgirl: The Game
elements.description: The game has been made. Through it, the saga of the Catgirls will be known to all.
elements.comments: Making a Video Game: This could be a major project using the Work verb. It would require a high level of several different stats (e.g., Passion, Reason, Funds), and yield a significant increase in the Catgirl level and a new Influence or Remnant (e.g., 'Fanbase' or 'Viral Game'). This project could also potentially spawn a new rival or adversary (e.g., 'Corporate Saboteur' or 'Internet Troll').
